AudioFlipper 1.3 can join its taskbar widget with RDPLauncher's, so the two work as one.

## New

- **Link with RDPLauncher**: with [RDPLauncher](https://github.com/Lucidic15/RDPLauncher) 1.1 or
  later running, right-click either widget, choose **Link with RDPLauncher** and which side
  RDPLauncher goes on. Linked, the two widgets sit side by side with a divider between them, and
  dragging either moves both. If one hides (all its sections turned off, a full-screen app, or the
  app exits), the other takes its place. **Not linked** separates them again, each staying where
  it is.

## Installing or updating

Download **AudioFlipper.exe** below. If you're updating, exit the running copy (right-click the
widget → **Exit**) and replace your old AudioFlipper.exe with the new one. Your settings are kept.
It's not code-signed, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info → Run
anyway**.
